description: This file provides shell script compatibility wrappers for the /sbin/uci command in OpenWrt. It includes functions to load configurations, set defaults, revert and set state, toggle options, add, get, remove, rename, and commit UCI configuration entries, with references to external /sbin/uci and /sbin/uci commands.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration for a given package, exporting variables for internal use.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration if none exists for a package.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI options to a previous state from stored variables.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets UCI options in the stored state.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI option, effectively toggling its state.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option from the stored state.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Gets a UCI option value, with optional default and state parameters.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI configuration section or assigns a type to a section.

methods.name: uci_rename
methods.description: Renames a UCI configuration option or section.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a value from a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts a UCI option to its previous state.
